description: Payment and liability legal reference covering invoicing and payment terms, late-payment consequences, and limitations of liability and indemnification concepts.

obligations.title: Invoice, Payment Timing, and Late Fees
obligations.description: Specify when invoices are due, how disputes are handled, and what happens with late payments (e.g., interest or service suspension subject to law and agreement).

obligations.title: Limitation of Liability
obligations.description: Define categories of damages excluded (e.g., consequential damages) and cap total liability, with carve-outs for specific liabilities if intended.

obligations.title: Indemnification for Third-Party Claims
obligations.description: Provide an indemnity mechanism and process for third-party claims, often including control of defense and allocation of settlement decisions.

obligations.title: Remedies and Allocation Consistency
obligations.description: Align remedies for breach with liability limits and define any exceptions that materially change the economic risk allocation.
